cues.en: That the thing works at all.
cues.zh: 这东西居然还能正常运转。

cues.en: It's 7PM,
cues.zh: 现在是晚上7点，

cues.en: and in homes up and down the country, cookers, heaters, television sets are being switched on.
cues.zh: 全国各地的家庭里，炊具、取暖器、电视机正被打开。

cues.en: At the National Grid Control Centre,
cues.zh: 在国家电网控制中心，

cues.en: national balancing engineer Simon Jeffcoat's on duty.
cues.zh: 全国电力平衡工程师 Simon Jeffcoat 正在值班。

cues.en: Arrayed on the wall in front of him is his view of Britain from above.
cues.zh: 他面前的墙上铺展着他俯瞰英国的视图。

cues.en: The country's been tipped on its side, and every high power electricity connection from the Far North Of Scotland to Cornwall has been mapped out in loving detail.
cues.zh: 整个国家被侧放，从苏格兰最北部到康沃尔的每条大功率电力连接都被细致入微地绘制出来。

cues.en: But Simon is bracing himself for the most difficult moment of his day,
cues.zh: 但 Simon 正准备迎接一天中最难熬的时刻，

cues.en: by
cues.zh: 靠

cues.en: watching EastEnders.
cues.zh: 看《EastEnders》。

cues.en: When the credits start to roll, he's gonna have to deal with a massive surge in electrical demand,
cues.zh: 片尾字幕一开始滚动，他就得应对电力需求的激增，

cues.en: what's known as a TV pickup.
cues.zh: 也就是所谓的电视负荷骤增。

cues.en: We're expecting
cues.zh: 我们预计

cues.en: a pickup
cues.zh: 会有一次骤增

cues.en: of around about
cues.zh: 大约为

cues.en: three gigawatts,
cues.zh: 3 吉瓦，

cues.en: which is 3,000
watts or equivalent
cues.zh: 兆瓦，或相当于

cues.en: to one and a half to one and three quarter million kettles coming on.
cues.zh: 150 万到 175 万只电水壶同时开启。

cues.en: So we expect the demand to pick up over
cues.zh: 所以我们预计需求会在

cues.en: a period of about five minutes.
cues.zh: 大约五分钟内上升。

cues.en: Power surges like this are unique to Britain.
cues.zh: 像这样的电力激增是英国独有的。

cues.en: No other country in the world switches on so many kettles in so short a time.
cues.zh: 世界上没有哪个国家能在这么短的时间内同时打开这么多电水壶。

cues.en: To cope with the strain, Simon has had to put specialized power stations on standby
cues.zh: 为了应对这种压力，Simon 不得不让专门的发电站随时待命

cues.en: as far away as Snowdonia
cues.zh: 远在 Snowdonia

cues.en: and Scotland.
cues.zh: 以及苏格兰。

cues.en: These hydroelectric
cues.zh: 这些水力发电

cues.en: plants can set thousands of tons of water plunging down the hillside at a moment's notice,
cues.zh: 电站一接到通知，就能让数千吨水从山坡上倾泻而下，

cues.en: generating huge bursts of power in a matter of seconds.
cues.zh: 在几秒钟内产生巨大的功率爆发。

cues.en: But Simon is also having to ask our neighbors across the channel
cues.zh: 但Simon还得请海峡对岸的邻居

cues.en: for a favor.
cues.zh: 帮个忙。

cues.en: To assist us with the end of
cues.zh: 为了协助我们应对

cues.en: EastEnders,
cues.zh: EastEnders 结束的时候，

cues.en: we have the French link picking up,
cues.zh: 我们让法国联络线开始增援，

cues.en: and they are picking up 600
cues.zh: 他们正在增加 600

cues.en: megawatts
cues.zh: 兆瓦，

cues.en: at a 100 megawatts a minute. So that's, again, a very rapid response.
cues.zh: 以每分钟100兆瓦的速度。所以这又是一次非常快速的响应。

cues.en: Simon is slave
cues.zh: Simon 受制于

cues.en: to this flickering frequency indicator,
cues.zh: 这个闪烁的频率指示器，

cues.en: which he has to keep as close as possible to 50 hertz.
cues.zh: 他必须让它尽可能接近50赫兹。

cues.en: If
cues.zh: 如果

cues.en: there's not enough power in the national grid, it drops off the scale.
cues.zh: 国家电网电力不足，它就会跌出量程。

cues.en: Too much, and it shoots off the other side.
cues.zh: 太过头，就会冲到另一头。

cues.en: And he has to judge his timing perfectly,
cues.zh: 他必须把时机拿捏得恰到好处，

cues.en: even if the BBC isn't quite working to schedule.
cues.zh: 即使 BBC 并不完全按时间表走。

cues.en: We we would be notified a time for the end of the program, and it hasn't actually
cues.zh: 我们会收到节目结束时间的通知，可实际到了那个时间它还没

cues.en: finished at that time. Which
cues.zh: 结束。这

cues.en: means?
cues.zh: 意味着什么？

cues.en: Simon fires off instructions for his keyboard. On the other side of the country, vast turbines rumble into life.
cues.zh: Simon 在键盘上飞快发出指令。在国家的另一边，巨大的涡轮机轰鸣着启动。

cues.en: Denorwicke
cues.zh: Denorwicke

cues.en: is up to one fifty. I've just instructed him up to 300 megawatts now. Fostenjog is up
cues.zh: 已达到 150 兆瓦。我刚指示他升到 300 兆瓦。Fostenjog 已升

cues.en: to 90 megawatts. It's full output.
cues.zh: 到 90 兆瓦。已是满出力。

cues.en: French polling in now.
cues.zh: 法国那边的轮询数据到了。

cues.en: Two minutes into the TV pickup, and it looks like there's going to be more than enough power to go round.
cues.zh: 电视用电高峰开始两分钟，电力看起来绰绰有余。

cues.en: And then suddenly, there's a problem. What
cues.zh: 然后突然出了问题。什么

cues.en: is it? Lovely allocations.
cues.zh: 问题？好极了，分配问题。

cues.en: Oh, is it a French thing? Yeah. There's a trip on the additional supply from France.
cues.zh: 哦，是法国那边的事？对。从法国来的额外供电跳闸了。

cues.en: Location's taking... The frequency has dropped dramatically.
cues.zh: 位置正在……频率已大幅下降。

cues.en: We're gonna be fine, I'm sure. Simon has just moments to cover the sudden shortfall.
cues.zh: 我们肯定没事。Simon 只有片刻时间来填补这突如其来的缺口。

cues.en: He rapidly sends out instructions to get one more hydroelectric
cues.zh: 他迅速发出指令，让又一座水电站

cues.en: plant online.
cues.zh: 并入电网。

cues.en: Then, once more, the supply heads back into the safe zone.
cues.zh: 随后，供电再次回到安全区间。

cues.en: It was immediate decision.
cues.zh: 这是立刻做出的决定。

cues.en: As soon as the frequency dropped through 49.8,
cues.zh: 频率一跌破49.8，

cues.en: I had to react.
cues.zh: 我就必须做出反应。

cues.en: The delicate balance of our electricity supply has been restored
cues.zh: 我们供电的微妙平衡已经恢复

cues.en: for now.
cues.zh: 但只是暂时。

cues.en: And across the country,
cues.zh: 而在全国范围内，

cues.en: a million kettles keep on boiling.
cues.zh: 上百万只水壶仍在沸腾。

cues.en: Britain's day is drawing to a close.
cues.zh: 英国的一天正接近尾声。

cues.en: By now, all that can be seen of Britain from above is illuminated by the power that Simon and his colleagues are squirting around the country.
cues.zh: 此刻，从空中能看到的英国全境，都被Simon和同事们输送到全国各地的电力点亮。

cues.en: 8,000,000 streetlights have flared into life.
cues.zh: 800万盏路灯骤然亮起。

cues.en: Office buildings
cues.zh: 办公楼

cues.en: blaze as our information economy trades on through the night.
cues.zh: 灯火通明，我们的信息经济彻夜交易不息。
